facts.fact: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed officially launched Digital Ethiopia 2030, described by the Ethiopian News Agency as a comprehensive national blueprint building on the Homegrown Economic Reform Agenda.
The Prime Minister said Digital Ethiopia 2025 had been completed after achieving its goals to an almost full extent, as the country moved to Digital Ethiopia 2030.

Digital Ethiopia 2030 was launched on 20 December 2025, succeeding Digital Ethiopia 2025, with enablers named as electricity, cybersecurity, a sovereign government cloud, broadband rollout and scaling Fayda ID and interoperable payments.

systems.tiers: national; the base on which Digital Ethiopia 2030 builds
